To help you find the right office furniture, it helps to categorize brands by their "vibe" and purpose, as the market ranges from high-end ergonomic design to budget-friendly home office solutions.

Here is a curated list of reputable office furniture brand websites, broken down by category:

### 1. High-End & Iconic Design (Corporate Standard)
These brands are the gold standard for ergonomics, durability, and modern office aesthetics. They are often found in major corporate headquarters.

*   **Herman Miller:** [hermanmiller.com](https://www.hermanmiller.com)
    *   *Best for:* Iconic ergonomic chairs (Aeron, Embody) and premium design.
*   **Steelcase:** [steelcase.com](https://www.steelcase.com)
    *   *Best for:* The world’s leading manufacturer of office furniture; excellent for heavy-duty office chairs and desk systems.
*   **Haworth:** [haworth.com](https://www.haworth.com)
    *   *Best for:* Combining sustainability with sophisticated, modular workspace furniture.
*   **Knoll:** [knoll.com](https://www.knoll.com)
    *   *Best for:* High-design, mid-century modern aesthetics for executive offices.
*   **Humanscale:** [humanscale.com](https://www.humanscale.com)
    *   *Best for:* Highly intuitive, minimalist ergonomic tools and chairs.

### 2. Direct-to-Consumer / Modern Professional
These brands primarily sell online, often cutting out the middle-man showrooms. They are very popular for home offices and tech-forward startups.

*   **Fully (by Herman Miller):** [fully.com](https://www.fully.com)
    *   *Best for:* Standing desks (Jarvis) and accessories; highly ergonomic-focused.
*   **Branch:** [branchfurniture.com](https://www.branchfurniture.com)
    *   *Best for:* "Office-in-a-box" solutions—high-quality furniture that looks professional but is easy to ship and assemble.
*   **Uplift Desk:** [upliftdesk.com](https://www.upliftdesk.com)
    *   *Best for:* The widest range of customization for standing desks and accessories.
*   **Secretlab:** [secretlab.co](https://secretlab.co)
    *   *Best for:* Gaming-style chairs that are increasingly popular in home office setups for their adjustability and durability.

### 3. Accessible & Trendy (Home Office Focus)
These brands prioritize aesthetics and price, making them perfect for residential-style work environments.

*   **West Elm (Work):** [westelm.com/shop/business-commercial](https://www.westelm.com/shop/business-commercial)
    *   *Best for:* Furniture that looks like high-end residential decor but is built to commercial standards.
*   **CB2:** [cb2.com](https://www.cb2.com)
    *   *Best for:* Modern, sleek, and slightly more affordable "apartment-friendly" office desks and shelving.
*   **Floyd:** [floydhome.com](https://floydhome.com)
    *   *Best for:* Modular, easy-to-assemble tables and desks with a distinctly modern, "forever furniture" design.
*   **Pottery Barn (Business):** [potterybarn.com/shop/business-commercial](https://www.potterybarn.com/shop/business-commercial)
    *   *Best for:* Traditional, sturdy, and elegant executive-style furniture.

### 4. Marketplace / Budget-Friendly
*   **Wayfair Professional:** [wayfair.com/business](https://www.wayfair.com/business)
    *   *Best for:* One-stop shopping for a huge variety of styles at competitive price points.
*   **IKEA (Office):** [ikea.com](https://www.ikea.com)
    *   *Best for:* Budget-conscious, minimalist, and space-saving organization solutions.

### A Quick Buying Tip:
*   **If you are shopping for a chair to last 10+ years:** Prioritize **Herman Miller, Steelcase, or Humanscale**. They offer excellent warranties and are engineered for 8+ hours a day of sitting.
*   **If you are setting up a home office to look good on Zoom:** Look at **West Elm Work or Floyd**. 
*   **If you are just starting out:** **Branch** offers the best balance of price and professional-grade quality for remote workers.
